guitar.notes: Original entry's vague 'session/live guitarists' + 'varied studio guitars' adds no verifiable info; better represented as unknown.

tone.target: bright jangly 60s pop clean with light spring reverb
tone.profile: bright jangly 60s pop clean with light spring reverb
tone.summary: A bright, jangly 60s pop sound achieved through a clean preamp (Green OD/Boost), coupled with the US Deluxe or Silver Twin amp model, finished with a Spring reverb and light EQ shaping.

rig.name: Alain Souchon - J'ai Dix Ans - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and hum.
Provide a subtle clean edge and boost the signal for jangle.
blocks.gap: The Green OD is used here as a gentle, transparent boost/overdrive to achieve the 'clean edge' without sounding like modern dirt.

alternatives.reason: A simple clean boost would also work well.

blocks.purpose: Bypass to maintain maximum clarity and avoid unwanted dirt.
blocks.gap: The target tone explicitly avoids fuzz or heavy overdrive, so the distortion block is bypassed entirely.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the clean, bright sound of a small American combo (Vox/Fender style).
blocks.gap: The US Deluxe is chosen for its classic, articulate clean headroom.

alternatives.reason: Also suitable for a bright, clean tone.

blocks.purpose: Provide a bright and focused cabinet sound matching the US Deluxe amp.
Brighten the high end and cut unnecessary low-end mud.
blocks.gap: Used to fine-tune the bright, jangly character required for 60s pop.

blocks.purpose: Introduce the required 'jangle' effect characteristic of 60s pop.
blocks.gap: The Chorus is used lightly to provide shimmer and width, fulfilling the jangle requirement without heavy modulation.

blocks.purpose: Provide the specified light spring reverb for vintage pop ambiance.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism to better match the vintage, jangly 60s pop aesthetic.

proposals.reason: A classic British cab will enhance the vintage, jangly 60s pop sound.
